ledgerSearch.outcome: No recorded decision forbids the restoration. CTD-0003 leaves the ontology of COHERENCE unsettled and CTD-0012 requires the currency, the unit, and the minting path to stay distinct, so the baseline's present tense for minting was moved to the conditional. The master ledger's Decision A and Decision B are not engaged here because this section names no unit and no stream. CTD-0073 is the governing item: it records that the volume's 57.8 percent compression was never approved, which is the warrant for restoring rather than defending the reduction.

findings.summary: The section was rewritten, not compressed. No sentence of the shipped text appears in the baseline.

evidence.baseline: 458 words across nine paragraphs and two ritual dividers.
evidence.shipped: 304 words. Checked against the baseline: Weather alters it, Later birds repair it, The nest must hold what we can now see, and belonged to the form all appear zero times in it.

findings.diagnosis: The rewrite preserves the section's content map, so this is paraphrase rather than the substitution found in v03-many-ways-to-fail. It is still not compression. Every sentence was replaced by a shorter sentence of the editor's own composition, which means the reduction cannot be audited as a set of removals, and the volume's opening voice is the editor's rather than the author's.

findings.summary: The nest image lost its argument and kept only its picture.

evidence.baseline: No bird builds one for itself. It is built by one generation, from whatever the season provides, to hold a generation that does not yet exist.
evidence.shipped: One generation makes it from whatever the season provides to hold a generation that does not yet exist. Weather alters it. Later birds repair it.

findings.diagnosis: No bird builds one for itself is the premise the whole image rests on, and it was cut. What survived is description. The volume card protects the nest becoming wiser about wind and weight as an image that must not be explained away; the shipped Each nest learns something about wind and weight is the explanation rather than the image. Restored.

findings.summary: The section's address to the reader and its two closing beats were deleted.

evidence.baseline: If you arrive from the second volume, you arrive having crossed a particular threshold. ... The ones not yet born are watching. This volume is for them, and it is theirs to finish. We begin.

findings.diagnosis: The volume card names light direct address as permitted and lists the ritual divider and a small number of earned narrative landings among its permitted fragments. We begin is the shortest of them and the one that tells the reader the front matter is over. Removing it leaves the continuity section ending on an abstraction about freedom to change, which is a statement about the book rather than an entry into it.

findings.summary: Five prohibited marks, each rebuilt to the job it was doing.

evidence.baseline: an honest accounting, established the ground, What it did not yet do, hold the line the whole series has held, and a generation that does not yet exist.
evidence.shipped: Not applicable. The rewrite removed the sentences that carried the marks.

findings.diagnosis: Three of the five introduced a specification and became colons. One fenced a parenthetical carrying its own comma and was rebuilt as a dependent clause. One separated two movements of the nest's life, from building to weathering, and became a period.

debtImpact.note: The item asks the author to compare baseline and revision aloud and decide whether the intervention was too strong. This section shows the comparison is not available as stated, because the shipped text is not a reduction of the baseline text but a replacement of it.
The baseline's how the currency is minted and circulated was restored in the conditional, so the section does not assert that a mint exists while the ontology of the unit is still an open query.

reasoning.note: The full baseline section: the threshold address to the reader, the three refusals of the second volume, the four things the second volume could not do, the risk that detail hardens into density, the reason the nest image returns, No bird builds one for itself, and the closing three beats.
R-PUNCT-STRUCT across five marks. Three colons, one rebuilt dependent clause, one period.

Every sentence of the shipped rewrite. None of it is baseline prose and none of it carries a recorded correction, so keeping it would mean keeping an unapproved developmental rewrite of the volume's first page.

how the coordination device actually works and how the currency is minted became would actually work and would be minted. Section 5 of the standard forbids describing a future institution in a present tense that reads as a report on an existing one, and CTD-0003 leaves the unit undefined.

openQuestions: Claim scope. The baseline says the volume will lay out how the coordination device actually works. Restored in the conditional under the standard's separation of vision from report. If the author wants the flatter, more confident promise back, that is a posture decision and belongs with CTD-0045.

Register. The restored section carries more first person plural and more direct address than the shipped text. The volume card licenses both at light intensity. Whether this opening sits at the right intensity is the author's judgment, and the restoration deliberately returns the baseline level rather than choosing a new one.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the stored text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, editorial/sources/corpus/voice-card.md, the volume-03 voice card, the master ledger, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. F1 refines the finding carried from v03-many-ways-to-fail. That section was substituted, this one was paraphrased, and both read as compression in a word count. A third category is now visible and worth naming for the rest of the volume: a section can keep its argument, its order, and its images while retaining none of its sentences. The damage map cannot see this, so the phrase check against the baseline must run on every section regardless of how small the delta looks.
